basic_profile.bio: I am an independent music producer and songwriter from Austin, Texas. I have been passionate about music since I was a teenager and turned that passion into a career. I enjoy experimenting with different genres, but I have a deep love for hip-hop and electronic music. When I'm not in the studio, you can find me at local live music venues or exploring the latest audio technology. I typically browse Reddit in the evenings, after a day of working on tracks. I'm single and dedicate most of my time to perfecting my craft.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have been creating music for over a decade, starting with basic software and gradually investing in more sophisticated equipment. I am self-taught, having learned from online tutorials and community forums. I also attend music production workshops and network with other professionals in the industry.
